column1: # Custom partition table — drops the OTA `app1` slot to give app0 the
# combined 2.56 MB. Per tasks.md TASK-035: hit the M-CHROME tier-2 flash
# wall when adding the SHUFREP atlas + shuffle/repeat overrides; the
# default 1.28 MB app0 was too tight (firmware.bin overflowed app0 by
# ~2.6 KB and the loader bootlooped). We don't OTA
# weight. SPIFFS + coredump kept at their original offsets so existing
# user data + nvs + otadata partitions remain unchanged.
